'''Battle Of Hoth''' was Players Committee '''Virtual Set 4''' in the pre&ndash;September 2009 numbered Virtual program. Overview and confidence notes: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. Era map: [[History of the Players Committee]]. Icon shorthand used on these sheets: [[Virtual card icons]].

== Launch vs later Remaster / Re-edit ==

Players Committee later redistributed nicer Remaster / Re-edit printable sheets (new pack/box art and Virtual set symbols) for the numbered Virtual Sets. The Wayback Resources copy of VirtualCards4.pdf is that later sheet: cover states Official text as of December 4, 2006 (footer: SWCCG Player's Committee 2006 on Dec 2006 family sheets).

Do not collapse launch packaging and the Remaster sheet into one unverified gloss: keep launch (or earliest documented presence) separate from the Remaster cover used here for pack and set-symbol art.

Narrative tip (Bill/Chief): PC remade Virtual cards to look nicer for this Remaster / Re-edit wave &mdash; launch-vs-remaster framing matches [[Virtual Set 1 (Original)]] Legacy sheet treatment. Do not invent symbol meanings beyond the PDF ICON KEY / cover (see [[Virtual card icons]]).

== Provenance ==

Primary Remaster PDF used for pack and set symbol on this hub:

* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf VirtualCards4.pdf] (IA)
* CDN day-to-day: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf VirtualCards4.pdf]

After the 2009 Block reorganization these cards were regrouped into [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Blocks]] / Legacy packaging; framing, errata, and legality can differ. Do not invent card text on this stub.

See also: [[Virtual Set 1 (Original)]] (Legacy sheet pattern), [[Defensive Shields]], [[Virtual Shields]], [[Virtual card icons]], [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]].
